# Moritex MML05-HR110D: telecentric lens, 0.5×, WD 110, with coaxial-illumination port

Source: https://www.moritex.com/Lens/203_9580.html. The STEP, drawing and datasheet are the vendor files.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | fixed magnification, object-side telecentric |
| Magnification | 0.50 ±5 % |
| WD | 110 ±5.5 mm (object distance 112.9) |
| Object to sensor (O/I) | 262.65 mm |
| Tube length | 135.12 mm (+4 thread); lens back 17.526 (C-mount) |
| Effective F/# / NA | 9.5 / 0.026 |
| DOF | 3.0 mm (circle of confusion 0.04 mm) |
| Resolution | 12.8 µm (550 nm) |
| Distortion | 0.028 % (1/1.8") |
| Telecentricity | 0.004° |
| Image circle | Ø11 (up to 2/3") |
| Mount | C-mount |
| Weight | 142 g |
| Outer size | Ø35 (front, 66.9 long), Ø22 tube, Ø29 at the mount |
| Coaxial port (D type) | Ø8 H7 (+0.015/0) light-guide bore, Ø16 boss, 26 from the axis |

With the Basler daA2448-70uc (IMX548, 1/1.8", 6.71 × 5.61 mm, 2.74 µm):

- **Field of view:** 13.4 × 11.2 mm.
- **Object pixel:** 5.48 µm.
- **Mount:** the camera is CS-mount, so it needs the 5 mm CS-to-C adapter ring (Basler 2200002382).

STEP frame: optical axis Z, mount thread at the top (z +91.47), front of the lens at z −47.64, coaxial port toward +Y.
